final: SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth) as avg_of_group_averages, AVG(group_count) as avg_of_group_counts FROM (SELECT observstation, weathprofile, COUNT(*) as group_count, AVG(bandusagepct) as avg_bandwidth FROM (SELECT t.observstation, o.weathprofile, t.bandusagepct FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.pointaccarc >= 4.86) GROUP BY observstation, weathprofile)
